connections.label: CEFAA / SEFAA - Chilean anomalous aerial phenomena office, Dirección General de Aeronáutica Civil
connections.note: Chile's DGAC dates CEFAA's establishment to 3 October 1997 and traces the reporting lineage back to 1968 at the old Oficina Meteorologica de Chile in the Complejo Aeronautico Quinta Normal, Avenida Diego Portales 3450, Santiago. After the 2021 reorganisation the successor body SEFAA sits at Av. Pedro Aguirre Cerda 5100, Cerrillos, Santiago.

desc: Santiago is the seat of Chile's civil aviation authority, the Dirección General de Aeronáutica Civil, within which the Comité de Estudios de Fenómenos Aéreos Anómalos has operated as an official investigative body staffed by serving and retired air force officers. CEFAA's directors, including General Ricardo Bermúdez, have spoken on the record about unresolved cases and have released military imagery for public analysis - most notably the 2014 navy helicopter infrared footage. Chile belongs on this board as a second working demonstration, alongside France and Brazil, that a state can run an acknowledged programme.
